PDF GPU-based Tiled Ray Casting using Depth Peeling
In this paper, we propose a new hardware-based ray casting algorithm for volume rendering of unstructured meshes. Unstructured grids are extensively used in computational science and engineering and, thus, play an important role in scientific computing.
